learning_outcomes.text: Understanding clearly what is spoken about everyday situations which a student meets at school or in his/her free time and speaking about them.
Writing in a simple way about familiar topics.
Reading and comprehension of simple texts.

syllabus_topics: Grammar: personal pronouns, ordinal numbers, time questions, verbs of movement, conditional, imperative
Conversation: at a restaurant, seasons, weather, at a post office, computer, telephoning
Technical part: units of measurement, mathematical expressions and operations
bibliography: Holá, Bořilová: Čeština krok za krokem 1, lesson 8 -11
internal materials of the Department of Languages
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
